Patients who are eligible for intracoronary stenting

OR.raw_text: Reference vessel size 2.5 mm by visual estimation

left.raw_text: At least one CTO lesions located in proximal or mid epicardial coronary artery. (If the patient has two CTO lesions, one CTO lesion should be located in proximal or mid epicardial coronary artery)

OR.raw_text: Angiographically defined total occlusion over 3 months

left.raw_text: If no definite symptom with total occlusion, two experienced operators decide CTO in consideration of angiographical morphology (degree of calcification, bridging collaterals, non-tapered stump, angiographic filling from collaterals)
